integrity: Proof and a standalone exact symbolic/rational reproduction script are supplied; finite checks support but do not replace the infinite-family argument.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies only to the completed classical RK4 step for finite connected noncomplete unit-edge undirected strongly regular graphs. It is not a stage-positivity or nonlinear SSP theorem. The graph-class cutoff and literature originality conclusions have not been independently audited.
title: Exact RK4 positivity for strongly regular diffusion graphs
